item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.7
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 7

A new look. Choose from four in Settings, General: Instrument, Flight, Night and Terminal. Each follows your Mac's light or dark setting.

Instrument is the new default: cool whites, near-black text and one orange for the things you act on.

Flight is bright and airy, with rounded cards. Night is dark with a quiet field of stars. Terminal is a code editor theme for keyboard people, with the transcript laid out like a file.

Every color is checked for contrast in all eight versions, and text never relies on color alone.

A quiet animation plays on the welcome screen and when no meeting is open. It stops when Reduce Motion is on.

If you picked Paper, Soft or Sky before, you'll see Instrument, Flight or Night.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.6
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 6

A design pass across the whole app. Every screen uses one spacing and type scale, and buttons and controls are easier to hit.

One name for each thing everywhere: Take Notes and Stop Taking Notes, Share with Attendees, How You Ran It. Menus use Title Case, and Settings is grouped by what you're trying to do.

Errors now say what happened and what to do next. A write-up that doesn't finish says what was kept and offers Try Again.

Empty screens say what the place is for and give you one thing to do.

Share is one menu, and the command palette shows each action with its keyboard shortcut.

Setup asks whether you manage people only when the answer changes something.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.5
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 5

Settings, Dictation has a dictionary you can search, edit, import and export, with names from your calendar and past meetings offered to add. Tailwing is in it to start with.

Snippets: say a short phrase and Tailwing types the text you saved for it, word for word.

When you correct a word Tailwing typed, it offers to add the word to your dictionary. "Suggest words from my edits" turns this off.

Your dictionary words are spelled your way in meeting transcripts and speaker names as well.

Notes stop when the Mac goes to sleep, and the meeting is written up as usual.

For builders, in Settings, Connections: a local API on this Mac, live events, a webhook or folder of JSON files after each meeting, tailwing:// links, Shortcuts actions and a Raycast extension. Each is off until you turn it on, and a private meeting never shows up in any of them.

A short line under How You Ran It points to private feedback on how you lead across all your meetings. Dismiss it, or turn it off in Settings, General.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.4
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 4

Setup downloads the speech model and then the writing model, with progress for each. The menu-bar icon stays dimmed until they're ready, and the setup window stays in front.

Every meeting opens on its write-up.

Dictation goes into the app you were typing in, even after you open Tailwing's menu or Settings, with a click when it starts and stops.

Pin on Top keeps the main window above other apps, and the side panel folds it into a column down the edge of the screen, with the live transcript above your notes. It opens by itself when notes start, and is hidden from screen shares.

Notes stop when a call goes quiet, even if the meeting app keeps the microphone, as Google Meet in Chrome can. A call that captured almost no audio says so and offers Delete.

Settings, Models can remove models you no longer use, and the calendar sign-in rows follow your sign-in.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.3
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 3

Steadier recording on calls: it keeps going when you switch headphones or microphones mid-call, and keeps the audio up to that point if a write fails.

Reliability fixes: your calendar stays in the menu bar when a read fails, cancelled meetings get no banner, and you can pause capture for an hour, until tomorrow or for a week.

Reset Tailwing, in Help, Troubleshooting, takes it back to first run.

The setup window opens in front of your other windows.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 2

Fixes a crash when a call app such as Zoom switched the microphone as the call started.

The menu-bar dot turns green while Tailwing is taking notes.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 1

The first beta of Tailwing for Mac. Tailwing takes notes on your calls and writes them up on this Mac.

Your notes, recordings and models move to a new folder the first time this version opens. Nothing is copied or uploaded, and nothing changes in the app.

Send Feedback, in the menu bar menu and in Help, writes us an email with your versions filled in.
